facts.fact: Gopal is the Shilak post's senior warden, grey at the temples, nine winters under Rohan; he reminds Rohan of the writ at the cairn and then salutes and enters Rohan's declaration in the post book.
facts.why: needed because the beat calls for 'Rohan's senior warden' to speak.

facts.fact: The bell Meera hangs on the cairn is Badami's large working bell (brass drum bell, green at the seams, worn tongue), fetched from the goat pen by Bindu. The small kid-bell was buried with Sunni at Ranu (F173).
facts.why: needed because the beat says 'Jassi's goat bell' but the kid-bell was buried in ch 19.

facts.fact: Bindu spun the new betrothal rope over the winter: undyed cream wool, two arm-spans long. Meera ties Rohan's warden's double hitch on his wrist; he ties her flat reef with half hitch on hers.
facts.why: needed because the beat calls for an ordinary rope of Bindu's new spinning, and the knots call back F116/F117.

facts.fact: Rohan's 'I am not arresting her' declaration is made publicly before the wardens at the cairn; Meera has already used 'Rohan' in private, and here she says it publicly as a chosen name.
facts.why: needed because ch 31 already had her say 'Rohan', so the beat's drop of 'Captain' is made public.

facts.fact: The carving of two hands on the cairn's inner face shows one broad worker's hand and one longer narrow hand, with the rope's end cut or untied at the foot; Meera notices the chronicle's 'brothers in arms' does not fit.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Meera look at the carved hands; a small observation, no new plot fact.
